when: the declaration is accepted and a storage is configured
reason: A new asset waits for its upload, and you get a URL that takes exactly the declared bytes straight to the storage, never through the API, for 15 minutes, with the headers the upload must carry. The URL is signed for the content type, the length and the SHA-256, so the storage refuses any other body.
evidenceRef: media: an intent for a photo is 201 with an upload URL

when: the content type is not one its kind takes
reason: An image is JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP; a voice note is MPEG-4 audio, Ogg, AMR, WebM or WAV. A type with parameters is refused too, because the value is signed and must be sent back exactly. Nothing is recorded.

when: the declared size is over its kind's limit
reason: More bytes than the kind allows: 10 MB for an image, 5 MB for a voice note. It refuses the upload, never an entry. Nothing is recorded.
evidenceRef: media: a photo over 10 MB is 413 MEDIA_QUOTA_EXCEEDED

when: no storage is configured, or it cannot be reached
reason: No storage is configured (production, until the owner makes the bucket), or none can be reached. Nothing is recorded; keep the entry's words and offer the photo again later.
